caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a man shown from the chest upward against a plain, off-white background. The man has short dark hair, a pronounced mustache, and light brown skin. His facial features include arched eyebrows, large eyes with a light blue iris, a straight nose, and closed lips. He is dressed in formal attire consisting of a dark-colored jacket with noticeable lapels, a cream or light yellow shirt, and a dark cravat tied at the neck. The jacket and cravat feature detailed shading and visible texture lines, giving the appearance of fabric folds and material wear. The background is unadorned, and the man is positioned centrally within the frame.
title: Sternpiece
